plan: Given my value of $31, I aim to bid slightly below this to maximize profit while considering the risk of losing the auction. Assuming others bid near their values, I will bid $30. This allows for a potential profit if I win, as I would pay the third-highest bid. I avoid bidding my full value to ensure a net positive gain. I expect others to bid close to their values, so bidding just below my value increases my chances of winning while maintaining a profit margin.

This balance maximizes long-term profit potential.

Given my private value of $40, I aim to bid strategically to win while maximizing profit. I'll bid slightly above the average expected value ($24.5) to increase my chances of winning, while ensuring the bid is below my value to maintain profit. Expecting others to bid around their values, I'll bid $30. This balances winning probability and profit maximization, assuming others bid near their values. This bid ensures I pay less than my value if I win, thus securing profit.
